name: io.github.rk-rishikesh/k01
title: k01 knowledge network
description: Read and contribute to ENS-owned, versioned knowledge namespaces: claims with sources, reviewers and history.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: The namespace to read by default, e.g. cancer-research.eth

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: The name this agent signs contributions with, e.g. <your-name.eth>. A label only; defaults to "reader"

environmentVariables.name: SEPOLIA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ethereum Sepolia RPC used to resolve ENS names (a public default is used if unset)

environmentVariables.name: PINATA_GATEWAY
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated Pinata gateway host reads are fetched through, e.g. my-gateway.mypinata.cloud

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_READER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key a sealed namespace granted access to (e.g. bought over x402). Opens grants in knowledge_read; never signs a transaction
